instruction: Set up a Thunderbird filter to forward all future emails received by anonym-x2024@outlook.com to work-backup@icloud.com. Configure this only in the local Thunderbird client, not in the online account settings.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (work-backup@icloud.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is work-backup@icloud.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original - single filter rule with no conditions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the Thunderbird filter rules file from the appropriate account-specific location (/home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/msgFilterRules.dat)
Metric (check_thunderbird_filter) properly parses the filter rules file and checks all required properties: enabled, action, actionValue, and condition
Expected values are semantically correct: enabled='yes', action='Forward', actionValue='work-backup@icloud.com', condition=['ALL']
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified (filter enabled, forward action, correct target email, applies to all emails)
Postconfig is appropriate: closes Message Filters window to ensure filter configuration is saved to file before verification
Data flow is correct: file getter → filter parser → rule matching logic

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
